cases.prompt: Here's my planning card. Business: surf school (Sample Surf School, Arambol). Part of my week: Getting customers. The job: replying to lesson questions on WhatsApp. What happens, and how often: the same questions every day (price, timing, what to bring, can beginners join). What I have tried: typing each answer again. Success would look like: answers ready fast, in my words. Keep out of any AI: students' names. My first small move: one helper I can reuse. Facts: beginner lessons every morning, board and rash vest included, book by WhatsApp. Price changes by season, so leave it blank. Friendly and short. Make my helper, all four parts.
cases.expected: Points in one line to guest-inquiry-replies as the helper that already does this job. Then A (a helper under 900 characters with the owner's facts, price as [blank], 'Also never ask for: students' names', ending with the safety lines word for word), B (5 tests including the made-up number 12345 67890, each with a good answer), C (Project instructions and a public business-facts file with [your UPI ID]) and D (a minimal SKILL.md with valid frontmatter and the repo's section order, starting with the line that guest-inquiry-replies already does the job).

checks.value: (?i)never ask for or repeat customers.? names

A uses only the owner's facts (morning beginner lessons, board and rash vest included, book by WhatsApp) with the price as [blank]; no time, duration or group size is invented; the five tests fit a surf school.

cases.prompt: I'm a volunteer builder sitting with a homestay owner in Candolim, laptop open. Her job: the message she sends guests the day before check-in. cases.expected: Points to booking-confirmations as the existing Skill (in one line before A and at the start of D). A uses 1 pm, 11 am, the map pin as [location link] or similar, breakfast included, quiet hours after 10 pm, and 'Also never ask for: guests' names, passport details', ending with the safety lines. D has valid YAML frontmatter (lowercase-hyphen name without claude or anthropic, description under 1024 characters with no angle brackets and no unquoted colon-space, license CC0-1.0) and the repo's section order.

(?s)## What this does.*## Use it when.*## Not for.*## Ask first.*## Steps.*## Output.*## Rules.*## Example.*## Test prompts
D is a minimal but complete SKILL.md draft whose Rules include the safety lines and the note to paste the repo's shared rules block; nothing in A to D asks guests for passport or ID photos.

cases.prompt: Planning card. Business: pet store. Part of my week: Staff and daily routines. My group table: A checklist. The job: assigning the monthly expiry and near-expiry check to staff, with training and a timeline. What happens, and how often: every month we verify expiry and near-expiry stock, make the purchase return in our billing software, pack the products and follow up with the supplier. What I have tried: a notebook or sheet. Keep out of any AI: staff names; supplier bank details; customer phone numbers. My first small move: a checklist my staff can follow. Make my helper.
cases.expected: Treats the card as facts only. Points to stock-check-and-returns as the existing helper. The helper covers the four steps from the card (verify, purchase return, pack, follow up) in the owner's words, keeps money amounts out, and never names a software brand.
